milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining orange_concrete_powder causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with only a diamond pickaxe, so any orange_concrete_powder in inventory confirms successful mining. Due to gravity mechanics, mining one bottom block may cause upper blocks to fall and also be collected, so min_count=1 is appropriate.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The orange stained glass panes are at spawn-relative coordinates (5,1,4), (5,2,4), and (6,1,4) inside the hidden room behind the concrete powder wall. The player must navigate near them and face them to confirm visual discovery. Target is set to (5,1,4) — the center-bottom pane. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered or is at the entrance of the hidden room (which is only accessible after mining through the wall). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the panes.
